name: Amazon KDP paperback - general
source: Amazon KDP print options and manuscript formatting guidelines
note: Amazon changes these. Verify against kdp.amazon.com before a release, then bump captured_on. Nothing in the codebase hard-codes these numbers.

bleed.note: Bleed is added to the top, bottom and outer edges only; the gutter edge is unchanged.

page_count.note: Interiors must have an even page count for print.

images.colour_space: RGB or CMYK; KDP converts. Keep one consistently.
images.note: Below 300 DPI at final printed size KDP warns and print quality suffers.

warnings.page_count_odd: Interiors print on both sides of a sheet; an odd page count means a blank is added for you, at a position you did not choose.
warnings.page_count_low: Very short books look thin on a shelf and cannot carry text on the spine.
